This is a VisePanda development test operated by Guangzhou Chuangjing Technology Co., Ltd. Contact JT at jtcao@go2china.space. If you consent, only your current input is processed by Qwen API, provided by Tongyi Yunqi (Hangzhou) Technology Co., Ltd. and its necessary processors. The dashscope.aliyuncs.com endpoint is publicly associated with Beijing access; actual internal inference locations, training use, retention periods and backup deletion timing are unconfirmed. Requests pass through Vercel in the United States and a local test worker whose observed network exit is Singapore; this does not establish its physical location. Your location is unknown. Text and answers are stored in Supabase in Singapore. VisePanda retains these records long term. Deletion or withdrawal hides them and stops further use; it does not promise physical erasure or recall requests already sent to the provider. This mode supports up to four turns per task. The model classifies only this message for general mainland China payment guidance (card acceptance checks, mobile merchant setup and obtaining RMB cash), adult foreign-passport domestic railway boarding documents, or ordinary mainland carrier SIM application documents/outlets and general call/data allowance checks. It does not establish eSIM or device compatibility, exact plan prices or allowances, live branch availability or internet access, and cannot activate a SIM. It does not carry out payments or transfers, verify specific card or merchant acceptance, or establish current fees, rates or limits. No previous messages, Trip data, memories, reviewed facts or source material are sent to it. Factual content is resolved by VisePanda from reviewed first-party publications. Saved answers are rechecked against their original evidence each time they are read; withdrawn, expired or conflicting content is hidden. Other needs may remain unanswered. Please restate your question in each message. Replies cannot change your trip and are not forwarded to another model. Team access is not enabled. You may decline or withdraw consent through the test entry. This development notice does not establish production readiness or zero provider retention.

When you send, this device securely keeps the request so a retry can continue it after an interruption. It is cleared when the request is recovered from your history, when its sharing permission is withdrawn, or when you sign out. Unsent drafts are not saved. Signing out cannot recall a request already sent.
